decision: Candidate B architecture with Candidate A staged validation requirements
feature_construction: Construct features after depth-only fold scaling; do not scale mask or age with the depth scaler.

architecture.head: Linear(64,15)
architecture.residual_semantics: Independent horizon changes from a shared anchor; not cumulative one-step increments.

anchor: Last quality-approved causal input; may be forward-filled, so it is not necessarily a fresh current observation.
postprocessing: Inverse-transform only depth; clip negative reported metre predictions to zero consistently across candidates.
retained_quality_gate: Existing past-only binning, observed-count, maximum gap, bounded forward-fill and freshness criteria remain prerequisites.
comparison_controls: Same folds, seeds, sampling, loss, checkpoint criterion and warning policy within each comparison stage.
stage_one_training: Masked MAE; hold training and checkpoint definitions fixed across C0/C1/C2 to isolate architecture effects.
stage_two_training: Compare selected architecture under masked MAE versus existing high-depth asymmetric MAE (weight 2); compare checkpoint criteria separately, not simultaneously with architecture changes.
stage_two_aggregation_control: If adopting event alignment, compute the masked mean per window and batch-mean those window losses under event-balanced sampling for both weight-1 and weight-2 controls. This differs slightly from the current batch-wide valid-label mean and must be recorded as a separate training change.
risk_checkpoint_candidate: Mean of per-window masked asymmetric errors within each event, then mean across events, converted to metres; use unclipped predictions for loss alignment and also report clipped operational metrics.
selection_metrics: Event-level warning lead time and timely recall under the fixed policy
False-warning episodes and duration on available continuous data
MAE by horizon, rising periods and input missingness
evaluation_boundary: Development comparisons use train/validation only; final test splits remain reserved until design and policy are fixed.
deferred: H32 capacity reduction as an isolated comparison
Candidate A residual q10/q50/q90 head with separate calibration and policy validation
Additional layers, attention, Transformer, enforced temporal monotonicity or smoothing
release_decision: No empirical superiority or operating safety has been established. Keep C0 as control; prefer C1 if the residual prior degrades the prespecified validation objectives.
